name: twitch
description: Twitch integration via the Helix API — search channels, browse live streams, top games, clips, videos, and channel info. Uses OAuth2 client-credentials (an app access token minted from your Twitch application's Client ID and Client Secret), which grants public/catalog data only — no followed channels, subscriptions, or chat. Tool output includes twitch.tv links for attribution; Twitch is a trademark of Twitch Interactive, Inc., and per the Twitch Developer Services Agreement API data must not be cached for more than 24 hours.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Twitch public catalog data via the Helix API (app access token)

fields.label: Client ID
fields.helpText: The Client ID of your registered Twitch application.

fields.label: Client Secret
fields.helpText: A Client Secret generated for your Twitch application (Manage > New Secret).

tools.name: twitch.search_channels
tools.description: Search Twitch channels by name. Returns channel id, login, display name, live status, current game, and twitch.tv URL.

live_only.description: If true, only return channels that are currently live

tools.name: twitch.get_streams
tools.description: List live streams, optionally filtered by game id, broadcaster login, or language. Returns streamer, game, title, viewer count, start time, and twitch.tv URL.

game_id.description: Only streams playing this game id (resolve with twitch.get_game)

user_login.description: Only the stream of this broadcaster login

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code, e.g. en, de, fr

tools.name: twitch.get_top_games
tools.description: List the most-watched games/categories on Twitch right now.

tools.name: twitch.get_clips
tools.description: List clips for a broadcaster or a game (one of broadcaster_id or game_id is required), optionally within a time window. Returns clip id, title, view count, URL, and creator.

broadcaster_id.description: Broadcaster id to list clips for

game_id.description: Game id to list clips for (resolve with twitch.get_game)

tools.name: twitch.get_videos
tools.description: List a broadcaster's videos (VODs). Returns video id, title, publish date, URL, and view count.

user_id.description: Broadcaster user id to list videos for

tools.name: twitch.get_channel_info
tools.description: Get channel information for a broadcaster: name, current game, stream title, tags, and twitch.tv URL.

tools.name: twitch.get_game
tools.description: Resolve a game/category by exact name to its Twitch id and box art URL (use the id with twitch.get_streams or twitch.get_clips).
